name: wheel-guard
title: Wheel Wake Guard
summary: The wheel waits for a button, in Settings.
description: When the screen light is off, the wheel does nothing until you push a button. Settings > Wheel Guard turns it On or Off.
details: The screen light goes off when the time of Settings > Backlight Timer has passed. After that, a touch of the wheel does not change the volume, the song or the list.
Push any button (Menu, Select, Play, Next or Previous) to use the wheel again.
Settings > Wheel Guard turns the guard On or Off on the iPod. The default is On. The iPod keeps the value in the file iPodFirmWheelGuard.
The buttons operate as in the Apple firmware. The Hold switch is not changed.
With Backlight Timer set to Off or to Always On, the patch does nothing.
notes: The wheel guard works on a real iPod (owner, 3 November 2026, version 0.1). The Settings item is not tested.
The screen light can still come on at a touch of the wheel. The patch stops only the action of the wheel.
The time starts at the last button push or wheel movement that the iPod accepted.
The text "Wheel Guard" is in English for all languages. On and Off use the text of the Apple firmware.
